sections.label: OEM Resources
sections.title: Your Collision Repair Network Partner
body: For improved customer satisfaction in your network that you can count on, count on I-CAR to help improve your vehicle brand experience.

sections.title: An Exceptional Repair Experience
body: Your collision repair network represents your brand after a collision. Leverage I-CAR's technical expertise, industry connections, and leadership to help them deliver exceptional repair experiences for your customers.

cards.title: Vehicle and Technology Specific Training
cards.body: Develop customized training around a specific model, repair process, or technology.

cards.title: Technical Resources
cards.body: Support collision repairers with industry-developed technical content and resources.

cards.title: Network Training Documentation
cards.body: Track and report on network training status to support business decisions.

sections.title: Network Strength
body: With over 9,500 Gold Class facilities nationwide, I-CAR can help you strengthen your network by identifying collision repairers who are committed to maintaining the highest level of industry-recognized technical training.

sections.title: Collaboration Programs
body: Invest in your network with these industry-recognized programs.

cards.title: Industry Training Alliance
cards.body: Reduce training redundancy and receive credit for approved partner training.

cards.title: Sustaining Partner Program
cards.body: Support collision repair training through an industry-wide partnership.

sections.title: I-CAR Academy
sections.label: What's New
body: A new program for shops and schools, I-CAR Academy empowers collision repair professionals through comprehensive education to attract, train, and retain talent in our industry.

sections.title: Reach Your Collision Repair Network Goals
body: I-CAR's customized solutions extend your team's resources and enhance the effectiveness of your network.
